newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - SHARES CREEPS HIGHER, SUPPORTED BY BANKS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - SHARES CREEPS HIGHER, SUPPORTED BY BANKS.

text.p: on the Tallinn bourse on Monday although business was slow as
the market opened later due to technical problems, dealers said.
Hoiupank was higher at 196.50/198.00 kroons compared to
194.30 kroons. Hansapank rose to 191.50/193 from 191 kroons.
Forekspank was up at 210/212.50 kroons compared to 209 kroons.
Dealers said the rise was expected to continue and push
prices even higher from the records made last week.
The market was held back slightly after trading began one
hour late due to technical problems.
"It feels as though the rise will continue although
Hansapank and Hoiupank are already too high," one dealer said.
The gains on the bourse started after banks released strong
half-year results, backed by demand from foreign investors after
